recommendedNewSections.heading: Benefits of Using an AI Meeting Assistant
recommendedNewSections.reason: To clearly articulate the value proposition, addressing a common user question and reinforcing the 'why' behind the software.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Improved productivity, accurate record-keeping, enhanced collaboration, better decision-making, time-saving.

recommendedNewSections.heading: AI Meeting Assistant Pricing: What to Expect
recommendedNewSections.reason: Competitors mention 'free' but lack a comprehensive pricing overview. This addresses a key user concern and helps with purchase decisions.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Free vs. Paid tiers, subscription models, features by tier, hidden costs, value for money.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Data Privacy and Security in AI Meeting Assistants
recommendedNewSections.reason: A critical concern for users, especially in professional settings. Only one competitor briefly touches on it.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Data encryption, compliance (GDPR, HIPAA), data retention policies, user control over data, ethical AI use.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Choosing the Right AI Meeting Assistant for Your Team
recommendedNewSections.reason: While some competitors discuss 'what to look for,' a dedicated, actionable guide is crucial for users making a decision.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Identify your needs, consider team size, evaluate integrations, assess features (transcription, summary, action items), check pricing, read reviews.

recommendedNewSections.heading: Future Trends in AI Meeting Technology
recommendedNewSections.reason: To provide forward-looking insights and establish authority, covering a topic generally missed by competitors.
recommendedNewSections.suggestedOutline: Advanced analytics, proactive suggestions, deeper integration with workflows, personalized AI assistants, ethical considerations.
